title: Atlas Flows: canonical flow URLs, actor badges and filters
summary: Atlas /flows with canonical URLs: /flows/<flow id> and /flows/<flow id>?step=<id>. Shows shared, default and mock links, step and branch deep links with drawers, 'Step not found', a legacy link redirected (308), 404 'Flow not found' states, AC-drawer links, and history sessions. Drawer open/close writes ?step= with history replace (no Back entries); drill and select push. Open build detail: the drawer scrim blocks a direct drawer switch. Flow-page quick wins (leafcutter/atlas-flows v4): every step card shows an actor badge (Code, AI agent, Person or Jev) and an accessible name; Enter opens a step's drawer; the drawer close button is named 'Close step details'; changing a filter never swaps the drawn flow and raises an 'Outside the current filters' notice instead; each flow page has its own tab title. The bare /flows address is no longer a drawn default flow: it is the finder, screen atlas-flows-finder. From leafcutter/atlas-flows v4.

provenance.note: Drafted from leafcutter/atlas-flows; revised the same day, before the first commit, to the owner-approved dataset edit (?step= step links and drawer, 'Step not found', legacy-link redirect, ?step= AC links); styled from the Atlas tokens via docs/ui-context.md (globals.css, layout.tsx).

Extended the same day, still before the first commit (version stays 1), to dataset v2 and the owner's mockup-gate decision of 2026-10-09: opening a step drawer writes ?step=<id> and closing removes it, with history replace (no new Back entries); drill and select still push. Added the drawer-history sessions (nav-drawer-replace, nav-drawer-in-history, nav-select-from-open-drawer) with address bar and history stack per action, and labelled the FlowDrawer scrim drawer-to-drawer switch as an open build detail.

Extended to dataset v4 (UXP-591 findability): replaced the 'Bare /flows keeps the default entry' section, which v4 retires, with a pointer to the finder screen; added actor badges and accessible card names (FlowNode), Enter-to-open and the 'Close step details' button, the 'Outside the current filters' notice (filter-replace session), and a tab title on every panel plus a titles table. Styled from the Atlas tokens via docs/ui-context.md (globals.css, layout.tsx).
